faq_1_q: How do I book the chalet?
faq_1_a: You can book directly via our website location-chalet-jostedalen.com, via Chalet-Montagne.com or through Airbnb. For a direct booking, contact us via the website form, SMS or WhatsApp. We will send you a rental agreement to sign and return along with a 30% deposit, preferably by bank transfer or by cheque.
faq_2_q: Is the rental only available Saturday to Saturday?
faq_2_a: During high season (winter and summer), rentals run Saturday to Saturday. Exceptions may be possible depending on calendar availability — feel free to contact us to discuss. Off-season weekend rentals are available.
faq_3_q: Is it possible to rent for a weekend?
faq_3_a: Yes, this is possible in spring or autumn, with a 2-night minimum. Not during high season (winter and summer), when rentals run Saturday to Saturday.
faq_4_q: Is it cheaper to book directly?
faq_4_a: Yes, direct booking rates are more advantageous as there are no platform fees.
faq_5_q: What is the capacity of the chalet?
faq_5_a: Chalet Jostedalen is a 240 m² triplex with 6 enclosed bedrooms (2 of which are under sloped roofs). It comfortably accommodates groups of 12 to 14 people (adults and children). It also has 2 baby cots (travel cots).
faq_6_q: How many bedrooms are there exactly?
faq_6_a: The chalet has 6 enclosed bedrooms, 2 of which are located under sloped roofs. These are full bedrooms, not mezzanines.
faq_7_q: How many living rooms are there?
faq_7_a: The chalet has 2 living rooms. A TV/children’s lounge on the first floor and a large living room with views under the rafters.
faq_8_a: Please contact us directly to discuss the possibility of bringing your pet. Each request is considered on a case-by-case basis. Please mention it when making your booking request.
faq_9_q: Is the chalet available in both summer and winter?
faq_9_a: Yes, the chalet is available all year round. In winter, you can enjoy the Sybelles ski area just 200 m away. In summer, the mountains offer numerous hiking and outdoor activity options.
faq_10_q: What does the direct booking rate include?
faq_10_a: The rate includes the rental price (varies by season) and cleaning fees. The tourist tax (~€1/adult/night) is payable online before your arrival via a secure payment link. Linen is optional.
faq_11_a: A 30% deposit is required upon signing the contract (preferably by bank transfer or cheque). The balance is due 1 month before your arrival as per the rental agreement terms. Bank details are provided at the end of the contract.
faq_12_a: Yes, a €1,000 security deposit is required. It must be paid separately from the balance by bank transfer or cheque before your arrival.
faq_13_q: When is the security deposit returned?
faq_13_a: The security deposit is returned by bank transfer after your departure and inspection of the chalet’s condition.
faq_14_a: Full refund if cancelled 60 days before your arrival.
faq_15_q: Do you offer rates for ski passes?
faq_15_a: No, we do not offer special rates for ski passes in the Sybelles area. You can purchase them directly from the resort or online on the Sybelles website.
faq_16_a: The chalet is rented without sheets or towels. You can bring your own or rent linen kits (sheets + towels) on site. Please let us know in advance if you would like this option.
faq_17_a: Yes, the chalet is equipped with single duvets.
faq_18_q: Is there linen and cots for babies?
faq_18_a: There are 2 travel cots with mattresses included in the rental. However, sheets and duvets for baby cots are not provided. We recommend bringing your own linen for little ones.
faq_19_q: Can we have the beds made on arrival?
faq_19_a: Yes, we offer the “beds made on arrival” option. Specify this when making your booking.
faq_20_q: Is an all-inclusive package with linen available?
faq_20_a: Yes, we can offer a rate including linen kits for your entire group. Contact us specifying the number of guests for a personalised quote.
faq_21_q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq_21_a: Check-in is from 5 pm and check-out is before 10 am.
faq_22_q: How does the welcome work on arrival?
faq_22_a: Someone will be available to welcome you on site or by phone. Their contact details will be provided before your arrival. You will also receive all access instructions (GPS address, entry code, WiFi, etc.).
faq_23_q: Where exactly is the chalet located?
faq_23_a: Chalet Jostedalen is located at the top of Saint-Sorlin d’Arves, at the place called Pierre Aiguë, in the heart of the Sybelles ski area. A GPS link will be sent before your arrival to facilitate access.
faq_24_q: What condition should we leave the chalet in on departure?
faq_24_a: The chalet should be left in a reasonably clean state: dishes done, bins emptied, duvets folded. A professional clean is carried out after each stay.
faq_25_a: Yes, the chalet is insured by the owner. However, each tenant must have their own personal liability insurance (included in most home insurance policies).
faq_26_q: Does the chalet have a jacuzzi/spa?
faq_26_a: Yes, the chalet has a private spa/jacuzzi. Safety rules must be followed: never leave children unsupervised, do not stay more than 20 minutes if the temperature exceeds 37.5°C, and always replace the spa cover after each use.
faq_27_a: Yes, the chalet has WiFi. Login details will be provided before your arrival.
faq_28_a: Yes, the chalet has AirPlay connected speakers in the upper living room.
faq_29_a: The kitchen is fully equipped including: an automatic bean-to-cup coffee machine (plus a filter coffee maker), 2 fondue sets and 2 raclette machines — perfect for convivial mountain evenings!
faq_30_q: Is there a ski rental shop nearby?
faq_30_a: Yes, a Skiset “CyberSki” shop is adjacent to the chalet. You can rent your ski equipment directly on site without needing a car. The slopes are approximately 200 m from the chalet.
faq_31_q: Does the chalet have a garage?
faq_31_a: Yes, the chalet has a garage that can accommodate one car. Important: the garage door must be securely closed at night to prevent any risk of pipes freezing.
faq_32_q: Are there travel cots for babies?
faq_32_a: Yes, the chalet has 2 travel cots with mattresses, included in the rental.
faq_33_q: Where can we park the cars?
faq_33_a: You can park one car in the garage and one or two cars in front of the chalet. It is important to keep the area in front of the chalet clear for traffic. For additional vehicles, spaces are available further up in the village or before the large bend before the chalet.
faq_34_q: Can you smoke inside the chalet?
faq_34_a: No, smoking is strictly prohibited inside the chalet, even with windows open.
faq_35_q: Are there rules regarding heating and windows?
faq_35_a: Heating is underfloor. We ask that you do not leave windows and doors open for extended periods, as extreme cold cools the chalet quickly and underfloor heating has significant inertia to regain the initial temperature.
faq_36_a: For safety reasons, balcony access is not permitted.
faq_37_q: What are the safety guidelines for the spa?
faq_37_a: Never leave children unsupervised in the spa. Do not stay more than 20 minutes if the temperature exceeds 37.5°C (risk of hyperthermia). Always replace the spa cover after use and reset the heating to 37.5°C.
faq_38_q: How do I pay the tourist tax?
faq_38_a: The tourist tax is approximately €1/adult/night (children are exempt). A secure payment link will be sent before your arrival. Simply adjust the number of guests and proceed with online payment before your stay.
faq_39_q: Are the slopes accessible on foot from the chalet?
faq_39_a: Yes, the slopes are approximately 300 m on foot from the chalet. A free shuttle also runs 30 m from the chalet for those who prefer not to carry their skis.
faq_40_a: The nearest chairlift is Les Choseaux. You can also take the free shuttle (stop 30 m from the chalet) to reach the ski lifts.
faq_41_q: Are the ski school (ESF) and ski lifts far from the chalet?
faq_41_a: Everything is easily accessible. The ski lifts are approximately 300 m on foot and the ESF is located at the ski lift area. The free shuttle (stop 30 m from the chalet) also takes you there.
faq_42_q: Is Saint-Sorlin d’Arves a family-friendly resort?
faq_42_a: Yes, it is a family-friendly resort with good snow coverage. It is connected to the Sybelles area which offers over 300 km of slopes.
faq_43_q: Is the village centre far from the chalet?
faq_43_a: The chalet is located at the top of Saint-Sorlin d’Arves, at Pierre Aiguë. The village has two centres: the village centre at the bottom and a snow front at the top closer to the chalet. The free shuttle (stop 30 m away) serves the entire resort.
faq_44_a: The chalet is semi-detached on the sides only. It is not an apartment on a floor: it is an independent 240 m² triplex with its own entrance, garage and garden.
